📓 Codex: The System granted you the Seed Vault — a finished The Living Garden build recognized.

The soil near you is warm. Things are growing that you didn't plant. Look at your hands. Look at what the light does around you now. You are The Living Garden — Blooming, Grown-Over. A figure half-lost in vines and blossoms — green-gold, flowers opening along the shoulders, roots at the feet. The ga

Godhood demands its price, and the price is not hidden: Once per day. It costs you 200 kcal of your own — the garden gives, but through you. You're not a fighter. Your garden needs guards, and everyone knows it.
